typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR as string,
		CLM_LINE_PROC_CD as string,
		CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD as string,
		CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT as timestamp,
		SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED SELECT ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR, pp.CLM_LINE_PROC_CD, pp.CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD,cl.CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT,PL.SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR FROM dbo.CLAIM cl  INNER JOIN dbo.MEMBER_LOOKUP ml ON ml.MEMBER_ID = cl.MEMBER_ID AND cl.CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT > DATEADD(month, -6, getdate()) AND cl.MEMBER_ID IS NOT NULL AND cl.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = \'N\' INNER JOIN dbo.CLAIM_LINE_PROCEDURE pp ON pp.CLAIM_ID = cl.CLAIM_ID AND pp.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = \'N\' AND pp.CREATE_DTTM >= ? INNER JOIN dbo.CLAIM_LINE CLML ON pp.CLAIM_ID = CLML.CLAIM_ID AND pp.CLM_LINE_SEQ_NBR = CLML.CLM_LINE_SEQ_NBR INNER JOIN dbo.PROVIDER_LOOKUP PL ON CLML.CLM_LINE_SVC_PROV_ID = PL.PROVIDER_ID GROUP BY ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR, pp.CLM_LINE_PROC_CD, pp.CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD,cl.CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT,PL.SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> IRProcData
IRProcData derive(CodeType = 'PROC') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(CodeType = CodeType) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_VALUE as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODESET_CD as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_PROVIDER_NBR as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_VALUE = CLM_LINE_PROC_CD,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODESET_CD = CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE = CodeType,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_PROVIDER_NBR = SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE = CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT)) ~> PDSOBMEMBERCODESSTAGING
